changes: The dashboard's log panel and the All logs window show the newest entry at the top. An error keeps its details (exception and stack trace) directly below it.

Settings, Document types: "Sample JSON…" next to "Import columns…" saves a SharePoint field template file for the selected type and company. It holds the entry's current target and columns, with examples where they are empty; edit it and import it back with "Import columns…".
E-invoice lines can carry a price per base quantity (priceUnit with priceUnitPrice, EN 16931 BT-149): an AX price of 60.45 per 100 pieces is written exactly instead of as a rounded per-piece price.

Line charges and line discounts (lineChargeAmount, lineDiscountAmount with optional reasons, BT-141 and BT-136) are written to the e-invoice, so a line with a surcharge adds up to the ERP's line amount again.

The deliver-to address (deliveryName, deliveryStreet, deliveryPostcode, deliveryCity, deliveryCountry, BG-13) is written; intra-community invoices no longer fail BR-IC-12 for the missing deliver-to country.
A cash discount sent as an amount without a percent gets its percent derived from the gross total; the payment terms no longer read "0 % Skonto".
The unit "st" (AX 2009 Stück) maps to C62 without a warning.

A document type that is disabled no longer has its input folder scanned. The installer default folder (C:\Temp\HiveBDC) on a type you never enabled caused an access error every 30 seconds; a folder shared with an enabled type is still scanned, and a disabled type's pairs dropped there go to the error folder as before.
SharePoint upload on a disabled document type no longer starts the SharePoint connection or shows SharePoint as on. Enabling or disabling a type applies on the next scan without a restart.
Settings, Document types: "Import columns…" moved next to the column templates of the company entry and imports the SharePoint target and columns for exactly that type and company from the file.

First release of Hive BDC (Balsoft Data Connector). It replaces Hive DocFlow: program, service, folders and Setup carry the new name (HiveBDC.exe, the HiveBDC service, C:\Program Files\Balsoft\Hive BDC and C:\ProgramData\HiveBDC).
Hive BDC is installed fresh. Uninstall Hive DocFlow first, then run the Hive BDC Setup and install the new license file from Balsoft (earlier license files are not accepted).
Copy your appsettings.json from the Hive DocFlow folder into the Hive BDC folder before the first start to keep companies, document types, SharePoint and mail settings.
Updates now come from the Hive BDC update feed.
The dashboard shows the version in three parts (1.0.0), the same as the update feed and the release notes.
